data.text: Baseline/randomization visit
data.sourceSection: SoA Table 1 - Schedule of Activities for Screening and Study Period 1

data.text: Primary endpoint visit (Week 12, Visit 6)
data.sourceSection: SoA Table 1 - Schedule of Activities for Screening and Study Period 1

data.text: For details about the transition of participants from Study Period 1 to Study Period 2, see the schema (Section 1.2) and the relevant notes in the SoA for Study Period 2 (Section 1.3.2).
data.sourceSection: SoA Table 1 - Schedule of Activities for Screening and Study Period 1

data.text: DXA scan must be completed at or within 7 days after V2. If rescan is needed and performed outside the 7 days, this will not be a protocol deviation.
data.sourceSection: SoA Table 1 - DXA scan row

data.text: At baseline, collect diary from participants who were not eligible for randomization (screen failed).
data.sourceSection: SoA Table 1 - Return daily eDiary row

data.text: FSH is optional; perform as needed to confirm postmenopausal status in individuals AFAB. See Sections 8.2.6 and 10.4.1 of the IIBD master protocol.
data.sourceSection: SoA Table 1 - Follicle-stimulating hormone (FSH) row

data.text: In addition to the fasting visits for lipids testing, site personnel can make fasting recommendations per local guidelines for the procedures.
data.sourceSection: SoA Table 1 - Laboratory tests and sample collections section

data.text: Lipids tested at fasting visits only.
data.sourceSection: SoA Table 1 - Lipids (fasting) row

data.text: For IOCBP only. Negative test required prior to dosing at marked visits. In Study Period 1, urine pregnancy tests will be done on site only. Additional pregnancy tests (urine or serum) should be performed at any time during the study if a menstrual period is missed, or there is clinical suspicion of pregnancy, or as required by local law or regulation.
data.sourceSection: SoA Table 1 - Urine pregnancy (local) row

data.text: FSH optional; perform as needed to confirm postmenopausal status in individuals AFAB.
data.sourceSection: SoA Table 1 - Follicle-stimulating hormone (FSH) row at Visit 4

data.text: Participants who had a TST will return 48 to 72 hours after placement to have their test results read. PPD test does not need to be read at the site but must be read by a trained medical professional, and the result must be presented to the site personnel prior to participant's randomization.
data.sourceSection: SoA Table 1 - Tuberculosis (TB) Test row

data.text: V7 will be conducted on same day as V6
data.sourceSection: SoA Table 2 - Schedule of Activities for Study Period 2

data.text: For details about the transition of participants from Study Period 1 to Study Period 2, see the schema (Section 1.2). Participants who received LY/mirikizumab co-administration or mirikizumab in Study Period 1 and who are considered responders at Week 12 of Study Period 1 will receive mirikizumab SC starting at Week 0 of Study Period 2.
data.sourceSection: SoA Table 2 - Schedule of Activities for Study Period 2

data.text: For responders to mirikizumab or LY/mirikizumab co-administration treatment, Visit 6 and Visit 7 will occur on the same day and the Visit 6 procedures are not repeated at Visit 7 (excluding 'Register visit with IWRS').
data.sourceSection: SoA Table 2 - Schedule of Activities for Study Period 2

data.text: Visit 8 and Visit 10 of the IIBD master protocol SoA do not apply to this ISA.
data.sourceSection: SoA Table 2 - Schedule of Activities for Study Period 2

data.text: FSH optional per investigator's discretion; perform as needed to confirm postmenopausal status in individuals AFAB.
data.sourceSection: SoA Table 2 - Follicle-stimulating hormone (FSH) row

data.text: Additional C. difficile testing is allowed throughout the study at the investigator's discretion.
data.sourceSection: SoA Table 2 - C. difficile testing row

data.text: Additional stool culture testing is allowed throughout the study at the investigator's discretion. Other local stool testing, for example, for ova and parasites, is allowed at the investigator's discretion.
data.sourceSection: SoA Table 2 - Stool culture row

data.text: Repeat injection training as needed.
data.sourceSection: SoA Table 2 - Injection training - mirikizumab SC row

data.text: The timing for the safety follow-up will occur 8 weeks after the last dose of study drug.
data.sourceSection: SoA Table 3 - Schedule of Activities for Unscheduled Visits, Early Discontinuation, and Safety Follow-Up

data.text: ECG needed at ED visit only if prior to Week 12.
data.sourceSection: SoA Table 3 - ECG row

data.text: At ED, the fistula evaluation is needed only when the ED is during Study Period 1. Evaluate for existing perianal fistulas (if present at baseline) and for any newly developed fistulas.
data.sourceSection: SoA Table 3 - Fistula evaluation row

data.text: At ED, the CDAI assessment is needed only when the ED is during Study Period 1.
data.sourceSection: SoA Table 3 - CDAI row

data.text: At ED, the DXA scan is needed only when the ED is during Study Period 1.
data.sourceSection: SoA Table 3 - DXA scan row

data.text: The daily eDiary will be applicable only to Study Period 1 and ED, if ED occurs in Study Period 1.
data.sourceSection: SoA Table 3 - Participant daily diary row

data.text: Lipids needed at ED visit only if prior to Week 12. Non-fasting lipids at ED will not be considered a protocol deviation, but fasting state should be recorded at time of collection.
data.sourceSection: SoA Table 3 - Lipids (fasting) row

data.text: FSH optional per investigator's discretion; perform as needed to confirm postmenopausal status in individuals AFAB.
data.sourceSection: SoA Table 3 - Follicle-stimulating hormone (FSH) row

data.text: HBV DNA at ED: this test is not required if done within the last 8 weeks.
data.sourceSection: SoA Table 3 - HBV DNA row

data.text: UACR needed at ED visit only if prior to Week 12.
data.sourceSection: SoA Table 3 - Urinary Albumin/Creatinine Ratio (UACR) row

data.text: IgG, IgA, IgM (quantitative immunoglobulins) needed at ED visit only if prior to Week 12.
data.sourceSection: SoA Table 3 - IgG, IgA, IgM row

data.text: Calcium (urine) needed at ED visit only if prior to Week 12.
data.sourceSection: SoA Table 3 - Calcium (urine) row

data.text: Exploratory biomarkers (blood) needed at ED visit only if prior to Week 12.
data.sourceSection: SoA Table 3 - Exploratory biomarkers, blood row

data.text: Exploratory biomarkers stool supernatant: Supernatant from the same stool sample used for fecal calprotectin testing. Needed at ED visit only if prior to Week 12.
data.sourceSection: SoA Table 3 - Exploratory biomarkers, stool supernatant row

data.text: Medical Monitor Name and Contact Information will be provided separately.
data.sourceSection: Title Page / Contact Information

data.text: Screening includes HBsAg and anti-HBc. If HBsAg is negative and anti-HBc is positive, further testing for HBV DNA is required.
data.sourceSection: SoA Table 1 - Hepatitis B virus (HBV) screening tests row

data.text: If HCV Ab test is positive, perform HCV RNA test.
data.sourceSection: SoA Table 1 - Hepatitis C virus (HCV) screening tests row

data.text: Site personnel must ensure the participant is trained on daily eDiary completion before the endoscopy visits. Provide additional training as needed.
data.sourceSection: SoA Table 1 - Daily eDiary training row

data.text: Site personnel must fully explain and confirm participant understanding of questionnaire before the device is provided to collect response.
data.sourceSection: SoA Table 1 - Dispense daily eDiary row

data.text: Collect all ongoing conditions and relevant past surgeries and medical history.
data.sourceSection: SoA Table 1 - Preexisting conditions and medical history row

data.text: Includes all CD-specific therapies since date of diagnosis.
data.sourceSection: SoA Table 1 - Prior treatments for indication row

data.text: The ICFs must be signed before any protocol-specific tests or procedures are performed.
data.sourceSection: SoA Table 1 - Complete informed consent row

data.text: Dispense stool collection kit as needed.
data.sourceSection: SoA Table 2 - Dispense stool collection kit row

data.text: In Study Period 2, urine pregnancy tests can be done on-site or at home.
data.sourceSection: SoA Table 2 - Urine pregnancy (local) row

data.text: AE collection should occur prior to the collection of the C-SSRS. Adapted for the assessment of ideation and behavior categories only.
data.sourceSection: SoA Table 1 - C-SSRS screening/baseline row
